notes.title: Witch Way V1.0.0 Released!
notes.content:
[p]First off, a huge thank you to everyone who offered their valuable feedback and suggestions during the Steam Next Fest, and across various social media platforms. Your advice helped us pinpoint issues in the game, but more importantly, it showed us just how many people care about what we're doing. For a small team like ours, that means the world.[/p][p]We've been working on this game for over a year, experimenting with different styles, tweaking mechanics, adding content, and streamlining the systems. Now that the game is released, we can say with full confidence—we gave it our all.[/p][h3]About the Game[/h3][p]For those new to "Witch Way" let me give you a quick rundown![/p][p][/p][h3]Link with the Witch, Defend the Village[/h3][p][/p][p]In this game, you've gained the power to control [b]Valentina[/b], a formidable witch, through a spiritual link! You can command her to corrupt the entire village and sacrifice villagers to unleash powerful magic, all to fend off waves of demonic attacks.[/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45098466/4148579f1fef68bcfdc57b2249ca788c2c5d40f7.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Core Gameplay: Corruption and Domination[/h3][p][/p][p]As a Witch, you don't just wield a variety of powerful skills; you can also [b]corrupt buildings[/b] to enhance their abilities. What's even better, you can assign [b]villagers[/b] to these corrupted structures, granting them additional bonuses.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45098466/827557a92650a57c654faad5dcce2eb2ae784a3d.png"][/img]
[/p][p]Of course, there's an unwritten rule in the game: as long as [b]one villager survives[/b], the game continues. This leads to a "clever" tactic: [b]Sacrifice[/b]. By sacrificing a villager, you can instantly activate a powerful, destructive magic, capable of turning the tide of battle! However, be sure to keep an eye on the number of surviving villagers—after all, you're supposedly "defending the village."[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Diverse Skills: Craft Your Dark Playstyle[/h2][p][/p][p][b]"Witch Way"[/b] offers a wide array of skills for you to mix and match. The witch you control can master a variety of [b]active and passive spells[/b]. Upgrading the [b]altar[/b] within the village allows you to [b]specialize your abilities[/b], while upgrading [b]arrow towers and walls[/b] gives you choices between offensive and defensive strategies. When upgrading the [b]barracks[/b], you can train soldiers with [b]different characteristics[/b] and grant them unique abilities.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098466/c7810c4092660de4d951b49766ed9786860177f9.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Craft Your Strategy[/h2][p][/p][p]But the most enjoyable part of the game is combining all these choices. For example, there's an enemy in the game called a "Treant." As everyone knows, wood fears fire. So, you can have your [b]ranged archers[/b] imbue their attacks with [b]oil[/b], while your [b]melee soldiers[/b] apply [b]fire effects[/b] to theirs. When a Treant is drenched in oil and then hit by a fiery attack, the raging flames erupting from it are truly spectacular![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45098466/5946de9577cf936d5f024eeee3ed7101c7c911ea.jpg"][/img]
[/p][p]There are many more combinations like this in the game, waiting for you to discover and master.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Ultimately, if you're tired of the same old hero-saves-the-world narratives and crave the fresh experience of [b]corrupting buildings[/b], [b]sacrificing villagers[/b], and [b]defending your village[/b], then head over to Steam and search for [b]Witch Way[/b] to begin an exciting journey! (By the time you're reading this, the game is officially available!)[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update V0.9!
notes.content: [h2]Skills[/h2][list][*][p][b]Skill Casting:[/b] No more automatic targeting! You now personally choose where your skills are unleashed.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098466/e6e4bfb62107bd512da7d3ccb3fc5770a7e7de74.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098466/0ecd2b0eeda8f0918837e55f1f36a5b0e444a4cb.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Skill Types:[/b] We've expanded your active skill slots to two! Your skill bar now includes Passive Skill, Active Skill 1, Active Skill 2, and Sacrifice Skill.[/p][/*][*][p]We've also refined the [b]visuals[/b] and [b]balanced the numbers[/b] for several skills.[/p][/*][/list][h2]UI[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098466/885ec4d806587674be3726a13901d3fef94267cc.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Building Interaction:[/b] The UI for interacting with buildings is now much clearer and easier to understand.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battlefield Overview:[/b] You can now directly see your [b]villagers' status[/b] (alive or fallen) right from the battlefield interface.[/p][/*][*][p]We've added a new [b]Battlefield Information Reminder Window[/b] to keep you informed.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Troops[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098466/ca667f20bad302dc8f52efadf132191d57d461fe.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Simplified Troop Deployment:[/b] Press [b]M[/b] to open the map, then click on a [b]barracks[/b] to rally your soldiers to a specific area. (Your soldiers will no longer be directly controlled by you.)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Troop Rallying:[/b] We've introduced two types of rallies: [b]Normal Rally[/b] and [b]Garrison Rally[/b]. Garrisoned soldiers won't move around, making it perfect for stationing your ranged units.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Summon Familiar:[/b] With a press of [b]F[/b], your Witch can now [b]summon her familiar[/b] right to her side.[/p][/*][/list][h2]What's Next?[/h2][p]This covers all the exciting updates in this Demo refresh! The full version of the game is coming soon.[/p]

notes.title: what's next for the content (01)
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][hr][/hr][p]We hope you all had a chance to check out [b]Witch Way[/b] at the recent Steam Next Fest! Have you recommended it to your friends yet?[/p][p]What's that? You haven't played our game about "a virgin little boy soul-linked with a sexy big sister defending the village, where the big sister can slaughter villagers and sacrifice them for ultimate moves if she's unhappy"?[/p][p]Well, you should definitely go try the [b]Demo[/b] first! [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3034180/Witch_Way/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]We've received a lot of feedback from players during the Next Fest Demo, and we want to thank you all for your support! Our team quickly gathered and discussed your suggestions and came up with some ideas. We know how bad it is to develop in a vacuum, so we've decided to share our upcoming development changes and get your input. We'll listen to every suggestion, and our ultimate goal is to make the game more fun and unique.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Combat Adjustments: Skill Casting & Soldier Control[/h3][p]This time, let's talk about [b]skill casting[/b].[/p][p]In the current demo, you just press [b]Q[/b] to cast a skill, and the Witch aims at the locked target. Our intention was to simplify things and make casting easier. However, the feedback shows that many of you actually prefer to decide the casting direction yourselves.[/p][p]So, we have two options for you:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098466/6ab40802458436f44e51d885d0f9e0b72a2dc351.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]A: Use a more established design.[/b] Press [b]Q[/b] to prepare the skill, and the mouse cursor will determine the casting direction. Release [b]Q[/b] to cast.[/p][/*][*][p][b]B: Less direct control over the Witch.[/b] You'd primarily control [b]"John, the virgin little boy,"[/b] and designate targets for the Witch. The Witch sister would then automatically perform regular attacks and skill casts.[/p][/*][*][p][b]C: Keep it as is.[/b] Don't change anything, developers![/p][/*][/list][h3]Which option do you think is [b]best[/b], or do you have an even [b]better idea[/b]? Let us know in the comments![/h3]

notes.title: New Big Update!
notes.content: [h2]Visuals:[/h2][p]A brand new visual presentation! Still mysterious and dark, but with a redesigned look![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098466/f86751a255d040b05f8eca22e03ac8b0bda870cc.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Story Background:[/h2][p]You, a pure-hearted young boy, are the only one who can command the witch Valentina. You must make her defend your village, which is on the verge of being torn apart by demons.[/p][p]Some villagers are chosen and called [b]Night Watchmen[/b]. They are sent to cages next to buildings to enhance the buildings' defense.[/p][p]When a true crisis strikes, the witch Valentina can, without hesitation, sacrifice the Night Watchmen's lives to summon powerful energy and resolve the immediate danger.[/p][p]So, will you [b]sacrifice[/b]? Or will you [b]protect[/b]? The fate of the villagers rests entirely in your hands.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098466/827557a92650a57c654faad5dcce2eb2ae784a3d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098466/3c74e005ea889b3c090cb300dbc9063beefe013e.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Combat:[/h2][p]Carefully select [b]active skills[/b], [b]passive skills[/b], and [b]sacrifice effects[/b], then combine them with the abilities of [b]buildings[/b] and [b]soldiers[/b] on the battlefield, as well as the [b]hidden abilities[/b] gained from deploying villagers.[/p][p]Create your own unique combat style![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098466/d9990a69437ee883ff32feb9e7d7aad1554d050d.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]We're thrilled to introduce so many significant changes in this version today.[/p][p]We hope everyone who's interested will come and play the new demo, and don't forget to add it to your wishlist! See you next time![/p]

notes.title: V0.1.1 Update!
notes.content:
[h3]- New:[/h3]
  - Added some dialogue during battles
  - Left mouse button operation: Keyboard and mouse players can now use the left mouse button instead of the spacebar to perform actions such as "build", "upgrade", and "enter night".
  - Wave reminder: The current victory condition will be prompted each round
  - Enemy information: You can hover over enemies with the mouse in the pause menu to view their descriptions.

[h3]- Adjustments:[/h3]
  - Fixed in-game stuttering: We have made significant optimizations, and in-game stuttering is now extremely rare.
  - Black Witch animation: Added a sudden stop animation when transitioning from running to stopping, making the movement more fluid.
  - Arch Demon: 
    - Animation is more natural
    - Increased size
    - The Arch Demon can be summoned when Chaos reaches 300.
Have fun!

notes.title: New Update is coming!
notes.content:
Here are the specific changes:
Have fun playing! We've got plenty of goodies for you, so check them out!
【New】
Familiar Summoning Animation: 
"How could a familiar summoned by sacrificing a villager sneak onto the field? Nope! Let's fix that!" 
Now, when the chaos value reaches a certain threshold, familiars will make a cool entrance. (Even if they're off-screen, you'll feel their presence.)
【Changes】
Main Interface:
 "The scene on the main interface didn't match the story we wanted to tell, so we've completely redesigned it."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098466/0cb7ece804ce43e74d9027708a4ed62015c8b6b9.png[/img]
More realistic rendering of the witch The background clearly reflects the location where events take place (a dungeon) Modified the shop and game start entrances
Shop Interface: 
"In the Nuclear Fusion version, we said there would be a priest and a boy in this UI, and now they're here." 
The UI has been completely redrawn, and the way information is presented has been reconsidered. Added a priest and a boy. We can't reveal their story with the witch yet, but you might find clues in the articles we post on our social media accounts.
Added Female Villagers: 
"Two heads are better than one"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098466/73be460fdb872cabdadff99139d09318bbbf5b41.jpg[/img]
Female villagers will now appear in houses. The two villagers that appear when upgrading a house are not necessarily male and female.
【Other Adjustments】
Witch Altar: Adjusted the texture mapping.
Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: V0.0.8 Update is coming!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
It's been over half a month since our last update. During this time, we've made adjustments to the keyboard and mouse controls, the tolerance system, and upgraded the rendering quality of the main base model. We hope you enjoy these changes!
Here are the specific changes:

【New】 
[b]Sacrificing Villagers: [/b]
"Sometimes, to gain power, sacrifices must be made. (Of course, the witch won't be the one sacrificed.)" 
- When the witch approaches a villager, press the prompt to squeeze the villager, just like the picture below!
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45098466/f61069e8725438fc94b5538576e6b2b0a3a162e5.gif[/img]

【Modifications】 
[b]Keyboard and Mouse Controls: [/b]
"Are your fingers getting tangled trying to speed up, move around, control soldiers, and cast spells at the same time?"
- The witch's movement has been changed from keyboard to mouse. Right-click to automatically move to the target point. Hold down the right mouse button to continuously control the witch's movement.
-  Adjusted movement speed and removed running.
-  Skill keyboard keys: Changed from Q-E-R to Q-W-E
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45098466/3ab6228c5e5b974efd52883dc191c9a684a672fd.gif[/img]
Tolerance System Major Adjustments: 
"After testing by our nuclear fusion player friends, we believe the tolerance system has been well-received by most people, but there is a need for adjustments in terms of performance!"
- Villagers have appeared in the village. 
- At night, villagers will flee back to their houses. If the houses are damaged, one villager will die. 
- If the witch cannot resist her thirst for blood, she can also actively squeeze the villagers, which will cause one villager to die but will increase her chaos value (increasing attack power and health, and summoning a small minion to assist when the threshold is reached). 
- Villager death will reduce tolerance. Tolerance will be restored at each sunrise based on the number of surviving villagers. (Perfect defense will not restore additional tolerance) 
[b]Some minor adjustments:[/b]
- Witch Altar: Adjusted the rendering method. 
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45098466/7c53625d105a762731bd681627ea72d12072bb57.jpg[/img]
- Spawn Points: Added some air walls.
- Fixed some bugs.
